advice: Abstain. The supplied evidence identifies no distinct legal experiment focused on streaming-region entry, exit, or ZA setup that also has a concrete wrapper change. The only evidenced way to reduce transitions was the sixteen-call panel32 wrapper, already measured: it passed correctness but did not show a repeatable gain over paired controls. Do not repeat it or claim a transition-cost result from those whole-call scores. A new transition experiment needs a concrete helper or assembly change that preserves the GEMM ABI and FP32 behavior; the evidence supplied does not define one.
risks: The measured panel result is joint evidence for the wrapper change, not an isolated measurement of streaming or ZA costs. Scores overlapped paired controls (candidate 1078.1–1090.8 GFLOP/s; controls 1067.0–1112.3), and none approached 1800 GFLOP/s. No causality can be assigned to its repeated SME transitions.
